responsibility: This header provides gm2’s internal assertion interface for GCC tree-building code. It defines assertion macros for arbitrary tree conditions, boolean-normalization checks, and generic conditions that diagnose through GCC internal_error/debug_tree, and it declares the location validator used to sanity-check source positions before building expressions, statements, and diagnostics.
same_name_distinction: This header is broader than the .cc file: it defines ASSERT, ASSERT_BOOL, and ASSERT_CONDITION macros and declares m2assert_AssertLocation for inclusion across gm2 code. Unlike m2assert.cc, it is the shared inline/assertion interface rather than the concrete location-check implementation.
